title: High nuclearity cerium–manganese clusters and their structural and magnetic properties: Ce3IVMn7III and CeIV5MnIII11

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Mn(O2CPh)2 (0.75 g, 2.25 mmol) was added to a hot stirred solution of benzoic acid (1.00 g, 8.25 mmol) in nitromethane (20 mL). After stirring 5 min, solid (NnBu4)2Ce(NO3)6 (1.01 g, 1.00 mmol) was added in small portions. The solution was stirred a further 10 min and filtered hot. The filtrate was left to concentrate for 5 days, giving small dark brown block-like crystals of 1·7MeNO2. Crystals for X-ray work were kept in mother liquor; otherwise they were collected by filtration, washed with hexanes, and dried under vacuum (40% yield based on Mn). Dried analytical sample corresponds to 1·5MeNO2.
synthesis.time: 5 min after Mn addition; 10 min after Ce addition; 5 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hot stirred aerobic solution; hot filtration; slow concentration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtrate concentrated 5 days to dark brown block-like crystals of 1·7MeNO2; washed with hexanes and dried under vacuum

properties.summary: Predominantly weak antiferromagnetic exchange among MnIII ions (CeIV diamagnetic). Combined dc and ac data indicate an S = 5 ground state with low-lying excited states. No out-of-phase ac signal down to 1.8 K (not an SMM under the reported conditions). Reduced-magnetization fit: S = 5, g = 1.95(4), D = −0.57(1) K.

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Mn(O2CPh)2 (0.75 g, 2.25 mmol) was added to a hot stirred solution of benzoic acid (1.00 g, 8.25 mmol) in nitromethane (20 mL). After 5 min, solid Ce(NO3)3 (0.87 g, 2.00 mmol) was slowly added (pale pink to deep red). Solid NEt4Br (0.10 g, 0.50 mmol) was added, the mixture stirred 5 min, then solid NnBu4MnO4 (0.18 g, 0.50 mmol) was added slowly in small portions over 2 min. After a further 10 min the reaction was filtered hot. Slow concentration of the filtrate over 5 days gave reddish brown block-like crystals of 2·6MeNO2. Crystals for X-ray work were kept in mother liquor; otherwise they were collected by filtration, washed with hexanes and dried under vacuum (30% yield based on Mn). Dried analytical sample corresponds to 2·2MeNO2.
synthesis.time: 5 min after Mn; 5 min after NEt4Br; NnBu4MnO4 over 2 min; further 10 min; 5 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hot stirred aerobic comproportionation; hot filtration; slow concentration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtrate concentrated 5 days to reddish brown block-like crystals of 2·6MeNO2; washed with hexanes and dried under vacuum

properties.summary: Weak antiferromagnetic coupling, weaker on average than in 1, with particularly low-lying excited states that preclude a unique ground-state assignment. Estimate S = 2 or 3 (or lower). No out-of-phase ac signal down to 1.8 K.

measurements.conditions: dried 2·2MeNO2; 300 K; 1 kG (0.1 T); powder in eicosane
